headline: 桃莉巴頓遺產惹威脅爭議
context: 已故創作歌手桃莉‧巴頓（Dolly Parton）的遺產管理方，指控她的姪子暨前保全主管布萊恩‧西佛（Bryan Seaver）涉及恐嚇與威脅，已申請保護令。西佛正是今年 8 月 25 日對外公布巴頓死訊的人，他否認相關指控。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Bryan Seaver, who announced Parton’s death to the world, is alleged to have intimidated her manager and others, which he denies The estate of the late Dolly Parton is involved in a dispute with the country star’s nephew and former head of security, and has filed for a restraining order against him amid allegations of threats. Bryan Seaver was responsible for Parton’s security, and was tasked with announcing her death on 25 August with a video, “something Dolly asked of me years ago”, he said. Continue reading...
sources.title: Dolly Parton estate in feud with nephew over alleged ‘warfare’ threats

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: Ms. Parton’s manager requested a restraining order against her nephew and former security provider, accusing him of threats and intimidation.
sources.title: Dolly Parton’s Estate in Turmoil After Extortion Accusations

voice_text: 桃莉巴頓的遺產，最近鬧上了法院。她的遺產管理方指控，姪子布萊恩‧西佛涉及恐嚇跟威脅，已經申請了保護令。西佛以前是巴頓的保全主管，今年 8 月 25 日，也是他親自對外公布巴頓的死訊。他否認這些指控。
